tool: 内置 image_gen（非 API/CLI 回退）
workflow: 先制作共用模板；生成火箭，再调整为统一 2D 画风；其余六张使用最终火箭无字插画作画风参考。插画与文字、边框分离。

prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create original premium collectible-card illustration art for the HEBUT aerospace exploration series, inspired by the broad nostalgic visual language of circa 2009–2013 cheerful Chinese social-browser collecting games, not any existing copyrighted card art or frame. Style: CLEARLY 2D hand-painted cartoon digital illustration, refined illustrative silhouettes, fine softly colored navy-blue contour lines, restrained brush texture, soft airbrushed color gradients and painted highlights, flat illustrative graphic construction with gentle shading, charming and dreamy but suitable for university students. Fresh restrained palette: HEBUT-inspired navy blue accents #163F65, sky blue, soft ivory, pastel accents. A single clearly readable hero object centered, large and elegant, recognizably engineered but simplified, moderate detail only. Keep the entire hero object inside the central 80% of the canvas with breathing space. Simple uncluttered atmospheric background, only a few purposeful accent marks. IMPORTANT: no words, no letters, no digits, no logos, no labels, no card border or frame, no name plate; text and frames will be added as editable layers later. No photorealism, no photographic textures, no CGI/3D toy appearance, no plastic toy, no clay, no vinyl figurine, no extreme gloss, no chibi, no googly eyes or facial features on machinery, no cyberpunk, no neon, no dense star confetti, no HUD, no complex mechanical ornament. Flat full-bleed upright illustration, aspect ratio approximately 5:6 (about 1024 by 1248 pixels), not an image of a physical card.

Card 01 / ROCKET, theme: setting out and ideals. A real-looking simplified white-and-cobalt launch rocket with a tall pointed main stage, two slender side booster stages, tasteful blue bands, and tiny structural seams. Three-quarter front view, rising diagonally only slightly toward upper right. The rocket occupies about 65% of the image height. A warm creamy yellow and pale orange exhaust plume descends into softly billowing white launch clouds at the bottom. Light azure daytime sky fading to warm ivory near the low horizon, two or three gentle cloud groups, a tiny pale crescent high in the sky if appropriate. Well-defined lovely illustration, visually warm, buoyant, optimistic. Keep the rocket nose and all boosters clearly inside the composition; use a graceful tapered rocket silhouette, no bulbous toy proportions.
prompts.refinement_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Re-illustrate this rocket scene as a refined nostalgic 2010-era casual browser-game collectible-card picture. The current reference is too realistic and cinematic; the finished version must read as friendly 2D cartoon game illustration, not a detailed anime movie background. KEEP the single white-and-blue three-core rocket rising, pale sky, warm yellow exhaust, and optimistic daylight idea. CHANGE the illustration treatment decisively: simplify the rocket to broad elegant graphic shapes with soft navy outline, remove most tiny panel lines and realistic metallic rendering, use gently painted two-to-three-tone shading. Make the central rocket a little broader and more iconic, without becoming a toy. Clouds should consist of a few large rounded cloud-lobe shapes with clear soft contours and restrained shading, NOT hundreds of realistic cloud wisps. Background should be a simple pale cyan/sky-blue to cream gradient, a small pale crescent, and at most a softly suggested distant landscape; no detailed realistic terrain. Flat painterly 2D game asset aesthetic, charming and polished, light hand-painted brush texture, crisp readable forms and soft highlights. Friendly university-campus collectible mood, dreamy but not babyish. Balanced medium shot with the rocket completely inside the central 80% of the frame. Portrait canvas approximately 5:6. Absolutely no text, no logos, no frame, no label, no anthropomorphic eyes, no 3D plastic, no photograph, no film poster, no intense lighting or realistic clouds. This is the definitive style reference for a matching seven-card collection.

The input is ONLY a painting-style reference: closely match its soft navy contour lines, broad graphic shapes, delicately brushed 2D paint, gentle two-to-three-tone shading, soft warm highlights, fresh pastel colors, refined friendly late-2000s casual browser-game collectible mood. Change the entire subject and environment as specified below. Do NOT include the rocket, its boosters, its flames or its original scene in the new image. Strongly 2D illustrative, clearly a cartoon drawing and not a realistic film-poster render. Do not copy any existing game assets, card frames or trademarks. Keep the hero fully visible with 10–12% breathing room from all four edges, about 65–75% of the image width/height; clear uncluttered composition. Background is simple and softly painted, with only a few small stars when in space; absolutely no dense glitter. Portrait approximately 5:6. No text, no letters, no digits, no logo, no frame, no title bar. No eyes or faces on machines; no photorealism, no 3D toys, no clay, no dense technical panel details, no neon, no HUD.

A curved blue-and-cream Earth limb occupies the lower quarter with two broad simplified cloud swirls; only three or four tiny warm star marks high in the sky. Palette: light cyan, sky blue, pale gold, ivory with navy outlines. A warm exploratory and friendly collectible illustration. No rocket, no exhaust, no extra spacecraft.
